summary: Historic Charm in Armathwaite. A former railway station built in 1876, The Old Station blends heritage and modern comfort. Four bedrooms (two en-suite), stunning sandstone fireplace, large garden, and breathtaking Eden Valley views—all in a vibrant village setting. Book your viewing today!
description:
Step into history with this exceptional former railway station, originally constructed in 1876 from beautiful local red sandstone. Brimming with character and charm, The Old Station offers a truly unique living experience in one of Cumbria’s most sought-after villages.

Inside, you’ll find a light-filled living room featuring an elegant sandstone fireplace—a stunning focal point that speaks to the property’s heritage. With four generously sized bedrooms, including two with en-suite facilities, this home provides ample space for modern family living without compromising on style or comfort.

Perfectly positioned along the historic Carlisle–Settle line, the property boasts breathtaking elevated views across the Eden Valley. Outside, a large, well-maintained garden invites you to relax and unwind, while private off-street parking ensures convenience for residents and guests alike. Armathwaite offers a vibrant village lifestyle with amenities including a shop, post office, primary school, two welcoming pubs, a church, and scenic woodland walks along the River Eden—all just a short stroll away.

This is more than a home; it’s a piece of history combined with modern comfort in an idyllic setting.

Don’t miss this rare opportunity—contact us today to arrange your private viewing and experience the tranquillity of The Old Station for yourself.

Directions Armathwaite is easily found from either Penrith or Carlisle by travelling on the A6 and turning off at High Hesket following the signs to Armathwaite. The Old Station is located adjacent to Armathwaite train station.

Services Oil powered central heating with mains electric, water and drains being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
